candidates.name: implement-rust-contract-crate
candidates.description: Implement one focused repo-com Rust 2024 library crate with its named contract test, workspace integration, and exact fail-on-zero-tests validation.
candidates.reason: All 31 implementation tasks use the same focused-crate, contract-test binary, workspace dependency, and exact nextest-selection pattern; a wrong test ID or empty selection is a repeated fragile failure mode.

candidates.name: model-repository-scoped-state
candidates.description: Implement or change a local repo-com state transaction with repository isolation, state-and-audit atomicity, rollback, and explicit no-remote side effects.
candidates.reason: The base schema, delivery claim, retention sweep, and confirmed purge all repeat transaction, uniqueness, rollback, cursor/count, and repository-isolation rules whose boundaries are easy to blur.

candidates.name: discord-v10-wiremock-testing
candidates.description: Build token-free Discord REST v10 wiremock contracts for authentication, permissions, messages, dynamic rate limits, bounded reads, and safe error classification.
candidates.reason: Client setup, message creation, inbound pagination, and delivery recovery all depend on exact v10 paths, Bot auth, server-directed limits, and proven-not-sent versus ambiguous outcomes.

candidates.name: guard-exact-tty-confirmation
candidates.description: Add an interactive operator confirmation bound to exact repository, object, revision or plan, scope, and hashes while failing closed in non-TTY mode.
candidates.reason: Policy activation, draft approval, secret override, and purge repeat the fragile exact-preview, hash-binding, 80-column, keyboard, audit, and automation-rejection sequence.

candidates.name: render-accessible-terminal-flow
candidates.description: Render and test a repo-com terminal flow as complete linear labeled output at 80 columns with no color dependency and a non-interactive fail-closed path.
candidates.reason: Outbound and operations presentation plus both handler families repeat wrapping, NO_COLOR, text-state, keyboard, snapshot, and stream-separation rules across many outcomes.

candidates.name: reconcile-unknown-discord-delivery
candidates.description: Recover an ambiguous Discord send using exact nonce and content reconciliation before any explicitly authorized new attempt, with conservative absence evidence.
candidates.reason: Unknown outcomes are the highest-risk duplicate boundary and require a fixed read-only, five-minute, three-read, multi-match, edited-message, and deleted-message procedure reused by recovery and end-to-end proof.

candidates.name: validate-cross-platform-release-gates
candidates.description: Validate the repo-com Linux, macOS, and Windows build, patched SQLite, secret, advisory, license, workflow, checksum, SBOM, and release-plan gates without publishing.
candidates.reason: CI and packaging tasks share pinned tooling, static SQLite 3.53.4 minimum, token-free evidence, matrix expectations, generated-artifact secret scans, and drift checks that are easy to satisfy partially.

candidates.name: validate-canonical-product-documentation
candidates.description: Keep repo-com operator, setup, security, threat-model, command, protocol, accessibility, and residual-risk documentation aligned with implemented contracts and free of prohibited claims.
candidates.reason: Five documents must stay synchronized with two handler crates, two renderer crates, lifecycle facts, and canonical requirements; missing topics and unsupported security or human claims are fragile release risks.

candidates.name: separate-automated-and-human-evidence
candidates.description: Keep generated tests, performance samples, documentation, and release artifacts distinct from human UX, security, live Discord, and final sign-off records.
candidates.reason: Four human-review tasks depend on implementation evidence while forbidding agents from inventing scores or attestations; a reusable evidence-boundary process reduces claim and file-ownership leakage.

candidates.name: run-rust-task-checks
candidates.description: Run the routine cargo fmt, clippy, and named cargo-nextest checks declared by each repo-com implementation task.
candidates.reason: The commands repeat but are deterministic, already explicit in every forge-task contract, and include task-specific binary or actionlint filters; wrapping them in another skill would duplicate authoritative commands and add drift.
